summary: NXG Cushing Midstream Energy Fund filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) disclosing that its Board of Trustees approved a name change and revisions to non-fundamental investment policies, effective December 18, 2026. The Fund becomes The NXG Cushing Energy Infrastructure Fund, keeping NYSE ticker SRV and CUSIP 231631300. The 80% policy shifts from midstream energy investments to energy infrastructure investments, pursuing high after-tax total return via capital appreciation and current income. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or closing condition applies; watch only for any future strategic actions.
